organization.name: Marconi Technologies
organization.description: Marconi Technologies is a Canadian-majority-owned, veteran-run defence technology company headquartered in Montréal that develops and manufactures tactical communications and networked mission systems for Canadian and allied users.

profile_data.portfolioScope: Resilient line-of-sight and beyond-line-of-sight tactical communications, high-capacity MANET radios, troposcatter, tactical SATCOM, sensor and cyber data fusion, and development-stage military cryptography.
profile_data.currentActivity: Marconi and Enamor International are scheduled to begin multi-year Orion X650 deliveries for Polish Cyber Command in 2026 under a contract exceeding C$10 million; Archer also completed a multi-day Swedish FMV evaluation in June 2026.
profile_data.evidenceBoundary: Products, ownership, locations, contract activity and public contacts are source-backed. Mission matches are derived analyst assessments, not procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest or classified demand.
profile_data.canadianFootprint: Headquartered at 5990 Côte-de-Liesse in Mont-Royal, Quebec, with development and manufacturing operations in Canada and additional locations in Germantown, Maryland and Tring, United Kingdom.
profile_data.ownershipAndHistory: Launched in May 2026 as a standalone, Canadian-majority-owned company after a Canadian investor group led by Louis Vachon acquired Ultra I&C's Tactical Communications division from Cobham Ultra; the business identifies itself as a descendant of Canadian Marconi Corporation.

organization.operating_context: Marconi Technologies is a Canadian-majority-owned, veteran-run defence technology company headquartered in Montréal that develops and manufactures tactical communications and networked mission systems for Canadian and allied users. Its published capability portfolio includes Orion Tactical Radio Systems, Archer Tactical Troposcatter, Hunter Tactical SATCOM Terminals. Its published program portfolio includes Orion X650 Polish Cyber Command Delivery.
organization.canadian_footprint: Marconi Technologies has a documented Canadian operating presence in Montréal, Quebec, Canada. Its public organization and capability evidence should be read at that location and national scope only where the cited sources explicitly support it.

reviewed_questions.context: Marconi Technologies's public evidence establishes its current role and offering, but it does not answer every access, configuration, eligibility, maturity or buyer question needed for a first business-development conversation.

capabilities.name: Archer Tactical Troposcatter
capabilities.summary: Deliver secure, high-bandwidth beyond-line-of-sight communications without satellite or fixed infrastructure using a rapidly deployable tactical troposcatter terminal. A June 2026 company-reported FMV evaluation sustained a frequency-diverse 75-kilometre link, integrated with a Swedish Armed Forces mobile network node, and used a two-person, under-20-minute fielding process.
features: Toolless setup and automatic antenna alignment
Direct integration with a Swedish Armed Forces mobile network node
Two-person fielding reported in under 20 minutes
applications: Communications in satellite-denied or degraded environments
Expeditionary operations in deserts, mountains and polar regions
Interoperable mobile-network-node backhaul during field evaluation

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: Archer could provide long-range, infrastructure-independent backhaul between dispersed edge-processing sites in northern or contested operating environments.

capabilities.name: SAMS Sensor and Cyber Data Fusion Platform
capabilities.summary: Development-stage platform intended to combine sensor and cyber data into a common operational picture for threat assessment, warning, system-health monitoring and distributed mission-system resilience.
capabilities.capabilityType: Development-stage sensor and cyber fusion platform

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: If delivered as described, SAMS could fuse local sensor and cyber observations into a distributed operational picture at the tactical edge; the product is currently marked coming soon.

applications: Air, land and maritime data transport
